race.comment: HASTA LA OINKERS (5) gets the nod after a sharp first-up third at Naracoorte, where he was beaten just under a length and travelled like a runner ready to win. Campbell Rawiller's booking and Sue Murphy stable form at this track add to a strong winning case. Placed to advantage so expect a big run. QUEEN OF THE TOP (12) is the immediate danger after lifting into third at Mortlake on soft ground, and her Hamilton fourth two back reads as useful Mdn experience despite the new 1550m task. Include. COIL (8) has more upside than most after being held up near the 200m on debut at Echuca. Further improvement is anticipated. FULLHEADOFSTEAM (4) will find this a little easier than his third just 10 days ago over 1600m at Morphettville. Draws in close and shapes as a major threat.
